name: indie-product-marketing
description: Evidence-backed opportunity discovery, demand validation, launch, acquisition, retention, and unit-economics workflows for indie products.

interface.shortDescription: Discover, validate, launch, and grow indie products.
interface.longDescription: Indie Product Discovery & Marketing helps solo developers and small teams mine evidence-backed problems, generate and rank product opportunities, validate demand before overbuilding, choose distribution channels, prepare a measurable launch, diagnose post-launch funnels, improve ASO and SEO, design ethical product-led growth loops, and decide when acquisition can scale. It separates observation from founder reports and hypotheses, protects AI ideation from convergence and vanity signals, and turns recommendations into bounded learning experiments.
defaultPrompt: Use $indie-idea-discovery to find and rank product opportunities I can validate.
Use $indie-product-marketing to validate and launch this selected product idea.
Use $indie-product-marketing to diagnose my acquisition, retention, and unit economics.
